info.name: Livestock ERP Financial Cashbook API
info.description: Postman collection for the implemented Financial cashbook APIs: cashbook setup, manual transaction drafts, confirmation, reversal, ledger, daily summary, and consolidated balances. All endpoints use /api/v1. Manual transaction creation requires an Idempotency-Key header. This collection does not cover staff advances, depreciation, period controls, or P&L.

request.description: Logs in and stores the Sanctum access token in the access_token collection variable.
Lists cashbooks within the authenticated user's branch scope. Optional filters: branch_id, type, status, currency_code, search, and per_page.

request.description: Creates an active cashbook and records its opening balance as a ledger entry. Opening balance may be omitted and then defaults to zero. Set branch_id to an active branch you can access. The name must be unique for that branch and cash/bank type.
Returns cashbook details and the system-calculated current balance.
Updates descriptive fields. Branch, type, currency, effective date, and opening balance cannot be changed after creation.
Deactivation is blocked while draft transactions exist or the current balance is non-zero.
Lists immutable ledger entries in posting order. Optional filters: from_date, to_date, direction, source_type, search, and per_page.

request.description: Returns opening balance, total In, total Out, and closing balance for one date or a date range.
Lists authorized transactions. Optional filters: cashbook_id, branch_id, status, direction, from_date, to_date, search, and per_page.

Creates a draft without changing the cashbook balance. Idempotency-Key is required. Keep the same key when retrying this request; change idempotency_key and external_reference to create a different transaction.
